description: JANAVI (Papermark fork) security boundaries: trust zones, enforcement points, internal auth, rate limits, and known gaps vs JANAVI DRM requirements. Update after touching auth, viewer APIs, or download endpoints.

public_internet: GET /view/:linkId (ISR page props, no secrets — password sanitized to 'protected')
viewer_sessions: Redis-backed httpOnly cookies: pm_ls_<linkId> (document, 23h), pm_drs_<linkId> (dataroom, 23h), pm_sas_* (agreement, 90d HMAC)
per-session 100 req/min; maxAccesses 1000; viewer-scoped revocation set viewer_sessions:<viewerId>

enforcement_points.password: app/api/views/route.ts:331-364 + views-dataroom:381-411 — legacy bcrypt or AES-256-CTR (salt:hash; key=sha256(NEXT_PRIVATE_DOCUMENT_PASSWORD_KEY)); encrypt-on-write lib/utils.ts:599-659; owner APIs return decrypted to team members only
enforcement_points.email_gate: emailProtected default true — validated before View creation
enforcement_points.email_otp: emailAuthenticated — 6-digit OTP VerificationToken (otp:<linkId>:<email>, 10min, single-use) then 23h sha256(token+NEXTAUTH_SECRET) token; downloads require session.verified
enforcement_points.recipient_restrictions: checkViewerEmailAccess (lib/utils/global-block-list.ts): link allowList/denyList + visitor groups → team globalBlockList; enforced in both view routes; denied attempts → ee access-notifications [EE]
enforcement_points.expiration: link.expiresAt checked at view + download + viewer page
enforcement_points.view_limits: GAP: no per-link max-view-count in this fork (only session-internal caps)
enforcement_points.download: allowDownload (+downloadOnly bypass) + ViewerGroup/PermissionGroup canDownload(+canDownloadOriginal); every download endpoint re-verifies session + view age (30min doc / 23h dataroom)
enforcement_points.watermark: viewing = client SVG overlay (components/view/watermark-svg.tsx) fed by watermarkConfig from /api/views; downloads = server-side burned into PDF content stream (lib/utils/watermark-pdf.ts via /api/mupdf/annotate-document, INTERNAL_API_KEY) — NOT applied to sheet/html/notion
enforcement_points.screenshot_deterrence: client-only hotkey interception + print:block overlay (components/view/ScreenProtection.tsx) — best-effort, cannot prevent OS capture
enforcement_points.print: GAP: no native print-disable toggle (only the ScreenProtection print CSS)
enforcement_points.copy: text selection disabled by default; enabled only via textSelection feature flag; no clipboard interception
enforcement_points.page_authorization: page-image URLs signed in ±10-page window at view creation; remaining lazy-signed per ≤15 pages via /api/views/pages (session + view age <23h + 60/min rate limit)
enforcement_points.original_exposure: KNOWN RISK: /api/views returns a signed full-file URL for pdf/image/video when hasPages=false (unbound to viewer, short-lived); JANAVI Protected Viewer must eliminate this path for restricted modes

rbac.roles: ADMIN | MANAGER | MEMBER | DATAROOM_MEMBER (enum Role, team.prisma)
rbac.matrix: lib/api/rbac/permissions.ts (verbs datarooms.read, documents.write, links.write, members.write, sso.write...; unknown role → deny-all)
rbac.wrappers: withTeam/withTeamApi (lib/api/auth/with-session-team.ts): session → membership ACTIVE+unblocked → role → permission → default-deny DATAROOM_MEMBER → plan → room entitlement (UserDataroom)
rbac.sso_enforcement: SSO-required email domains reject non-SAML signin (lib/api/teams/is-saml-enforced-for-email-domain.ts) [SAML itself EE]

crypto_secrets.NEXTAUTH_SECRET: JWT signing + token hashing (link-verification, agreements HMAC)
crypto_secrets.env_policy: never hardcode; JANAVI adds DB_*, REDIS_*, BEACON_API_TOKEN (see .env.janavi.example)

rate_limits_upstash.factory: lib/redis.ts ratelimit(n, window) — @upstash/ratelimit sliding window, prefix 'papermark'
sites: OTP send/verify both view routes (1/30s email + 10/min IP)
rate_limits_upstash.note: lib/redis.ts dual-transport: Redis Cloud (ioredis Lua sliding window, keys janavi:dev:ratelimit-*) or Upstash REST or fail-open stub when unconfigured; edge middleware never rate-limits via Redis

tenancy.storage: S3 keys teamId/docId/... — presign proxy verifies session user's team matches key's team
tenancy.db: every query team-scoped via teamId; dataroom room-scoping via UserDataroom + access-control rows
tenancy.cross_tenant_risks_to_test: link resolution by id (enumeration), views/pages cross-view access, download cross-view, presign proxy key parsing, custom-domain slug collisions

ee_licensed_note: ee/ + app/(ee)/ deleted 2026-10-16; zero imports remain. Auth, RBAC, tenant isolation, link access policies, rate limits and INTERNAL_API_KEY service auth all preserved through the billing/enterprise removal.
edge_middleware: Edge cannot reach Redis Cloud (ioredis Node-only) → lib/middleware/domain.ts no longer reads the per-domain redirect override from Redis; always uses JANAVI fallback URL. Auth gate + /view rewrites unaffected. /register now public (self-hosted signup).
